aggressive_definition_excerpt: The reduced risk of prostate cancer associated with allium vegetables was independent of body size, intake of other foods, and total calorie intake and was more pronounced for men with localized than with advanced prostate cancer.
reason: The abstract analyzes overall incident prostate cancer and explicitly compares localized with advanced disease, but the advanced-disease statement is for allium vegetables collectively.

exposures.supporting_excerpt: Similar comparisons between categories showed reductions in risk for men in the highest intake categories for garlic (OR = 0.47, 95% CI = 0.31 to 0.71; P(trend)<.001) and scallions (OR = 0.30, 95% CI = 0.18 to 0.51; P(trend)<.001). The reduced risk of prostate cancer associated with allium vegetables was independent of body size, intake of other foods, and total calorie intake and was more pronounced for men with localized than with advanced prostate cancer.
exposures.endpoint_definition: Garlic: prostate cancer overall; total allium vegetables: localized versus advanced prostate cancer.
exposures.reason: Garlic is analyzed only for prostate cancer overall. The localized-versus-advanced finding is attributed to allium vegetables collectively, and the abstract does not establish a garlic-specific advanced incident association.
